description: P1 Architecture & UX: ComingSoon page, Error Boundaries, Push Notifications hook, Unread counts, Deep linking, Offline indicator, Image optimization
steps: 1. Create src/pages/ComingSoon.tsx: A polished 'Coming Soon' page with the app's dark theme (bg-black/bg-[#050505]), a rocket or construction icon from lucide-react, a title 'Coming Soon', subtitle 'This feature is under development', and a 'Go Back' button using react-router-dom's useNavigate(-1). Use framer-motion for a subtle entrance animation. Follow the pattern of other pages in the project.

2. Replace NotFound imports in App.tsx: Change all lazy imports that point to './pages/NotFound' for PLANNED features to point to './pages/ComingSoon' instead. This includes all the Ads, Organization workspace, Admin OS placeholder modules, Executive workspace, Security, Company, Automation, KIP, AI, Production, Governance, Decisions, Reports, Command, Trust&Safety, Verification admin, Support admin, Engineering, Finance/Legal, Security dept, and Platform routes. DO NOT change the actual 404 catch-all `<Route path='*' element={<NotFound />} />` or the explicit `const NotFound = lazy(() => import('./pages/NotFound'));` declaration used for the catch-all.

3. Create src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx: A React class component error boundary with: componentDidCatch logging, a graceful fallback UI (dark themed, 'Something went wrong' message, 'Try Again' button that calls window.location.reload(), 'Go Home' link). Export both ErrorBoundary (class) and a functional wrapper.
4. Wrap App with ErrorBoundary: In src/App.tsx, wrap the entire app content (inside QueryClientProvider) with the ErrorBoundary component.

5. Create src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts: Hook that uses @capacitor/push-notifications. On mount: check if running on native (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()), request permission via PushNotifications.requestPermissions(), register with PushNotifications.register(), listen for 'registration' event to get token, save token to Firestore at `push_tokens/{userId}/tokens/{token}` using the Firebase user from useAuth(). Listen for 'pushNotificationReceived' and 'pushNotificationActionPerformed' events. Return { token, permissionGranted }.
6. Register push notifications in NativeInit: In src/hooks/useNativeApp.ts, import and call usePushNotifications().

7. Fix unread counts in AppShell.tsx: Replace the placeholder useEffect with real Firestore listeners. Use onSnapshot on a query: collection 'notifications' where 'user_id' == user.uid and 'read' == false (count results for unreadNotif). For unread DMs: query collection 'conversations' where user.uid is in 'participants' array and has 'unread_count_{uid}' > 0 (or simpler: query 'conversation_members' where user_id == uid and unread_count > 0). Use onSnapshot for real-time updates. Import db from src/lib/firebase.ts. Clean up listeners on unmount. Remove the supabase import since it won't be used.

8. Add deep linking to capacitor.config.ts: Add an `appUrlOpen` handler configuration. Add `server: { url: 'https://aurelix.app' }` or use the plugins.App.appUrlOpen pattern. In the Android manifest (android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml), add an intent-filter for deep links with scheme https, host aurelix.app.

9. Create src/components/OfflineIndicator.tsx: A component that listens to navigator.onLine and online/offline events. When offline, shows a fixed top banner with amber/yellow background: 'You are offline. Some features may not work.' Use framer-motion AnimatePresence for enter/exit animation.
10. Add OfflineIndicator to AppShell.tsx: Import and render OfflineIndicator at the top of the app shell container.
11. Image optimization: In relevant components that render images (PostCard, profile avatars), add loading='lazy' attribute to img tags. Search for
acceptance_criteria: src/pages/ComingSoon.tsx exists and renders a polished coming-soon UI
All ~268 NotFound lazy imports for planned features in App.tsx now point to ComingSoon
The actual 404 catch-all route still uses NotFound
src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx exists with proper error catching and fallback UI
ErrorBoundary wraps the app in App.tsx
src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts exists and handles Capacitor push notification registration
AppShell.tsx uses Firestore onSnapshot for unread notification and DM counts
AndroidManifest.xml has intent-filter for https://aurelix.app deep links
src/components/OfflineIndicator.tsx exists and shows when offline
findings: All 264 NotFound lazy imports replaced with ComingSoon (1 remains for the actual NotFound component used by the catch-all route and 2 inline element usages). Build and tests pass cleanly. The ExecutivePlaceholders const was a plain function (not lazy), also updated to ComingSoon. Image loading=lazy added to PostCard, HighlightsRail, CollabInviteSheet, and NewHighlightSheet media images.
